description: Rename AZURE_BACKEND_URL to BACKEND_URL across the edge worker, update .env.shared, CI/CD workflows, infrastructure, and documentation to remove all Azure references. Rename infra/azure/ to infra/gcp/ with Cloud Run equivalents.
steps: Step 1: Edge Worker - Rename AZURE_BACKEND_URL to BACKEND_URL in: (a) apps/edge/src/env.d.ts - Change the Env interface field, (b) apps/edge/src/index.ts - Replace all occurrences of env.AZURE_BACKEND_URL with env.BACKEND_URL, update comment mentioning 'Azure Container Apps', (c) apps/edge/wrangler.toml - Rename AZURE_BACKEND_URL vars/secrets references to BACKEND_URL, change the production default from azurecontainerapps.io to a placeholder like MUST-BE-CONFIGURED.run.app, (d) apps/edge/src/routes/api-proxy.ts - Update the JSDoc comment that says 'Forwards requests to Azure Backend' to 'Forwards requests to Backend'.
Step 2: Edge Worker Tests - Update AZURE_BACKEND_URL to BACKEND_URL in: (a) apps/edge/tests/api-proxy.test.ts, (b) apps/edge/tests/contract.test.ts, (c) apps/edge/tests/latency-audit.test.ts.

Step 3: Update .env.shared - (a) Remove entire P2 section (Azure Compute), (b) Remove entire P3 section (Azure Search), (c) Add a new P2 section for Google Cloud Run with: BACKEND_URL (Cloud Run service URL), GCP_PROJECT_ID (same as VERTEX_PROJECT_ID), GCP_REGION. (d) Update P6 section to note it also handles search. (e) Update edge bindings section: rename AZURE_BACKEND_URL to BACKEND_URL.

Step 4: Update .github/workflows/deploy-all.yml - (a) Remove the entire deploy-backend job that uses Azure (ACR build, Container Apps deploy, KeyVault secrets). Replace with a Cloud Run deployment job that: builds Docker image, pushes to Artifact Registry, deploys to Cloud Run. Use GitHub secrets for GCP credentials. (b) Remove the rollback job's Azure rollback steps, replace with Cloud Run revision rollback logic. (c) Update smoke-test job comments. (d) Remove azure/login action references.

Step 5: Rename infra/azure/ to infra/gcp/ - (a) Delete all Bicep files (*.bicep) and dashboard.json and search-index.json from infra/azure/. (b) Create infra/gcp/ directory. (c) Create infra/gcp/clouddeploy.yaml with Cloud Run service definition (container port 8000, min instances 1, max 10, memory 1Gi, cpu 1). (d) Create infra/gcp/vertex-search-schema.json with the equivalent Discovery Engine datastore schema matching the fields from the old Azure search-index.json.

Step 6: Update infra/scripts/ - (a) Rewrite infra/scripts/deploy-search-index.py to deploy a Vertex AI Search datastore schema using the Discovery Engine Admin API. (b) Rewrite infra/scripts/seed-search.py to seed documents into a Vertex AI Search datastore using the Document Service API.
Step 7: Update docker-compose.yml - Remove any Azure-related comments. The compose file is already Azure-free (just mongo/redis/backend) so just update the .env reference comment if needed.

Step 8: Update README.md - (a) Replace P2 row: 'Google Cloud | Cloud Run | FastAPI backend, orchestration'. (b) Replace P3 row: 'Vertex AI | Search (Discovery Engine) | Hybrid RAG (BM25 + Vector + Semantic Rerank)'. (c) Update deployment section to reference Cloud Run instead of Azure Container Apps. (d) Update troubleshooting section: remove Azure Search troubleshooting, add Vertex Search troubleshooting. (e) Update configuration section: remove Azure env vars, show new GCP vars. (f) Update cost optimization table. (g) Remove Azure Monitor from monitoring section. (h) Update security section: remove Azure KeyVault reference, mention GCP Secret Manager.

Step 9: Update apps/backend/app/services/ai/router.py comments and apps/backend/app/services/ai/cloudflare_client.py - No functional changes needed, but ensure no Azure references in comments or docstrings across the backend app directory.

Step 10: Clean up frontend admin references - In apps/frontend/src/components/admin/AdminHealth.jsx, AdminCronJobsCard.jsx, AdminAzureAiPanel.jsx, and vertex-panel/StatusHeader.jsx: update comments and references from Azure to GCP/Vertex. Note: AdminAzureAiPanel.jsx should be renamed or its content updated to reflect GCP services.
acceptance_criteria: No occurrence of 'AZURE_BACKEND_URL' exists anywhere in the codebase (grep returns empty)
Edge worker TypeScript compiles: pnpm --filter syrabit-edge exec tsc --noEmit passes
.env.shared has no Azure sections, has new GCP Cloud Run section
deploy-all.yml references Cloud Run instead of Azure Container Apps
infra/azure/ directory no longer exists, infra/gcp/ exists with clouddeploy.yaml and vertex-search-schema.json
README.md architecture table shows Google Cloud / Cloud Run for P2 and Vertex AI / Search for P3
